name: @mandusec/policy-mcp
description: Mandu policy agent surface (docs/design/ui/policy-surface.md §8.5.1): an MCP stdio server that lets the confined agent read the law, test a flow, and propose typed edits. A tightening applies at once; anything that loosens protection is filed as a proposal the user approves on the dashboard's Approvals page. Every result is a token-only JSON envelope the arbiter's inbound policy trusts by exact name + shape (arbiter/policy/policy-tool.ts). Zero runtime deps (hand-rolled stdio JSON-RPC, skeleton copied from interceptors/inspect-mcp).
